content:
This region is the working record of development on this site.

Belongs here: what was changed in code, templates or configuration, the reason for it, how it was tested, and anything left unfinished or deliberately deferred.

Does not belong here: what the version control history already tells you. Record the reasoning and the traps, not the diff.

Recurring errors from the log belong here when they are defects in this site's own code or templates: record the cause, whether it is harmless, and what was done about it. Findings that bear on safety go to scope.site_security, and errors caused by the server or its configuration go to scope.site_environment. Use the error's own wording as a mnemonic, so it can be found again from any region.

description: 2026-09-06: fixed three shipped placeholders that produced broken markup (black, hover_text, hidden) and one misspelled title, directly in cms_token.
content:
Three placeholders shipped with defective replacement text and produced broken output on every page that used them. Found while documenting the set in scope.info_placeholders, fixed on 2026-09-06. | Id | Was | Now | |---|---|---| | `black` | `` | `` | | `hover_text` | `%text%` | `…"]>%text%` | | `hidden` | `
%text%<
` | `…%text%` | | `l_optout_confirmation` | title "Opt-opt confirmation" | "Opt-out confirmation" | `#black` is not a valid CSS colour and was silently ignored; the stray `/` in `hover_text` closed the span before the text, so the tooltip covered nothing; the extra `<` in `hidden` left a malformed tag in the page. The fourth is cosmetic — a Backend label only. **How.** Four targeted `UPDATE cms_token SET text = REPLACE(...)` statements through the Backend's SQL console (Datenbank → SQL-Konsole), one per id, each reporting one row changed. `REPLACE` rather than a full assignment, so nothing else in the text could be disturbed. **Verified.** Re-read the rows, then rendered both structural fixes through the placeholder preview (`ifc_message=display&ifc_page=token&object=…`): `black` now emits `COLOR:black`, `hover_text` emits `text`. `black` and `white` are now identical in shape. **Note.** The placeholder cache clear (token module → *clear placeholder cache*) timed out when invoked over MCP; the previews were correct regardless. If a stale value ever appears on the live site, run that command from the Backend directly — it walks the cache directory and takes a while. **Still open.** These are database rows, not files, so the fix does not travel with a release. A fresh installation ships the defective values again until they are corrected at the source of the seed data.
